OLTRE LO SPECCHIO / BEYOND THE MIRROR
Suspended between dream and architecture, FENDI presents Cruise 2027 by Maria Grazia Chiuri

Powerful and distant, her protagonist moves slowly through an uninhabited rationalist building in Rome, an austere space designed to capture the movement of light, where emptiness and matter, geometry and silence exist in constant dialogue, and the garments, like the figures who wear them, become part of a motionless, feverish landscape - abstract yet intensely real

The House reveals the full-length film on FENDI.com
title: FENDI Cruise 2027 by Maria Grazia Chiuri teaser

description:
OLTRE LO SPECCHIO / BEYOND THE MIRROR – FENDI CRUISE 2027

Like a fairytale suspended between dream and architecture, FENDI presents Maria Grazia Chiuri’s first Cruise collection in a short film. Her imagined Suzie – inspired by the protagonist of Histoire d'Eau by Jacques de Bascher – moves slowly through an uninhabited rationalist building of twentieth-century Rome: an austere space designed to capture the movement of light, where emptiness and matter, geometry and silence exist in constant dialogue. The garments, like the figures who wear them, become part of this motionless, feverish landscape — abstract, yet intensely real.

description:
The Maison is proud to present its latest Hand in Hand #FendiBaguette created with Made For A Woman in Madagascar.

Conceived across Italy in 2020 and expanded worldwide to the USA, Japan, China, and Scotland, #FendiHandinHand is a grassroots partnership between Fendi and local artisans that celebrates the #FendiBaguette by Artistic Director of Accessories and Menswear Silvia Venturini Fendi as an icon of the Maison and an instantly recognisable canvas for perpetual transformation.
 
The Baguette crafted by Made For A Woman reinterprets traditional Malagasy designs into an intricate pattern of different stitches. Working with locally sourced raphia, the artisans created the bag from four different crochet squares tied together, outlined by three-toned raphia with fringed edges. A macramé braid runs over the Baguette, its flap and shoulder strap, embellished with exquisite carnelian beads.
title: The making of the Fendi Hand in Hand Baguette Made For A Woman in Madagascar

The #FendiHandInHand project once more goes beyond Italy to pursue the finest craftsmanship from around the world, this time visiting the Scottish Highlands to celebrate the country's rich textile heritage.

There, Clare Campbell's Prickly Thistle – Cloth of Identity elevates the concept of tartans by weaving words, numbers, and symbols into their fabrics. For her interpretation of the #FendiBaguette, Clare worked with Fendi's traditional colourway and signature yellow, as well as the numbers five, for the five Fendi sisters, 1925, the year Fendi was founded, 1997, marking the creation of the Baguette, and 2008, the debut of the Peekaboo.

The resulting tartan is now registered within the Scottish Register of Tartans.

description: One year ago, the first #FendiCouture collectiondesigned by Kim Jones was unveiled.
